title: C55 · Privacy as the Seventh Capital

story.text:
# 💡 C55 · Privacy as the Seventh Capital
**concept** · shared · knowledge

Privacy is the seventh kind of capital, foundationally; its character is land-based RENTIER capital (data as soil): it yields rent by position, not value by aggregation; its worth is the appropriation share the consent interface sets; its exposure erodes on the adversary's background-information clock (C82); and it is leased, never conveyed — structural inalienability by non-reconstruction (C97) is the ownability mechanism. Compounding is scoped to reputational fertility only, never to raw records. Character re-typed 2026-07-17 (First-Person soil ruling, L149). Tome III Act III.9. Resonance Mana (🔭) is the 7th Capital in motion.
